description: At an outdoor music festival at dusk under a stormy grey sky, a smiling man in a black T-shirt with headphones around his neck pushes up a fader on a large mixing desk, and its rows of level meters glow brighter. Beyond a barrier a huge crowd raises their arms towards a stage lit by spotlights and haze, where a band plays. A young woman in the crowd cheers with a raised hand. Then the man, grinning widely, cups a hand to his mouth and shouts towards the stage.

taps.phrase: to cheer with a raised arm
